snippet.textDisplay:
3:00:22 nothing but love for ya brother but this is a very clear sign that the only reason you feel living in a house with guns would be "scary" like you said earlier is because youre not educated on how they function. 

Racking the slide back like that locks the firing pin back, so when you pull the trigger while dry firing, it actually releases the firing pin forward. If you dont rack it, the firing pin doesnt release and you dont learn how to properly aim and manage the firearm. Not only that but it builds up good muscle memory for if you are live firing and have a jam or some other weapon malfunction, most of the time racking quickly will resolve the issue and could save your life if youre in a combat scenario. 

I got love for ya man but damn you seem to be throwing a lot of jabs at Americans lately without really knowing what youre talking about and it sucks because so many of us have so much respect for ya and know youre a good guy.
